rewriteInstruction: Anchor the entire section to observable homepage changes only. In the first H3, quote the old headline and describe what it assumes (developer familiarity with deployment workflows). In the second H3, quote the new headline and meta description, then note what new capability categories appear (AI, infrastructure). In the final H3, replace all sales-process speculation with a specific homepage audit: compare the number of capability nouns in the old vs. new headline, or count how many CTAs require zero commitment vs. form-fill. End with a 5-minute founder test tied directly to Vercel's evidence — e.g., 'Write down your homepage headline. Circle the nouns. Are they outcomes (speed, performance) or capability categories (infrastructure, workflows)? Vercel shifted from outcome to capability — does your headline do the reverse?' Never claim the page 'sets up a sales conversation' or 'expects procurement involvement' without CTA, form, or conversion data to support it.
